source_context: Turoth are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 55 to kill. They are melee based, and as such Protect from Melee will negate all of their damage. They drop herbs and seeds commonly, though not as frequently as aberrant spectres , as well as frequent nature runes . In addition, they also drop the leaf-bladed sword and necklace of fangs .

Turoth, like kurask , can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons , broad arrows and bolts , or the Magic dart spell due to their thick hides. [ 1 ] Turoth are immune to other types of attacks, thereby establishing hidden skill requirements to kill them (particularly for ironmen ). Though most of the means available for attacking them cannot inflict poison, it is still possible to inflict venom by using either a serpentine helm or a toxic staff of the dead with Magic Dart . This also means the dwarf multicannon is ineffective, and cannot be placed in this area.

Although turoth are invulnerable to any damage from the eldritch Nightmare staff , Saradomin godsword , and toxic blowpipe special attacks, they will still heal the player as if it would have dealt damage, making them useful as special attack weapons during extended trips. The ancient mace special attack also restores Prayer points equal to the damage that would have been dealt. Guthan's equipment's set effect does not work.
The majority of the Turoth in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon are level 83 and 85, along with three level 87s, and one level 89.

Slayer rings offer immediate access to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon . For those without access to Slayer rings, a fairy ring (code: A J R ) is conveniently located outside the dungeon. Other alternatives include the lyre , Fremennik sea boots and Teleport to House if the player's house is located in Rellekka . Players who are unable to use any of these options can use a Camelot teleport and make a long run north/north-west towards Rellekka and then east after passing the second bridge. Alternatively, players may teleport to Lunar Isle without a Seal of Passage and talk to an NPC to be kicked off the island to Rellekka; they may also teleport to Waterbirth Island and take the boat to Rellekka.
Drop rates are estimated based on 1,788,457 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

source_context: Gargoyles are Slayer monsters located in the Slayer Tower 's top floor and basement, requiring 75 Slayer in order to be harmed. Those found in the basement are only available to players who are assigned gargoyles as their Slayer task . If they attempt to kill them off-task, Raulyn will prevent them from attacking.

Gargoyles, like rockslugs , cannot be killed normally. In order to kill a gargoyle, a rock hammer , a rock thrownhammer , or a granite hammer must be used when they reach 8 or lower Hitpoints . Normally, the item must be used on the gargoyle, but players can buy the " Gargoyle Smasher " perk from Slayer Masters for 120 Slayer points , which will automatically smash the gargoyle when it falls to 9 or lower Hitpoints, provided that the player has a rock hammer (or equivalent) in their inventory. The granite hammer will automatically smash gargoyles even without the perk if it is equipped.
Because of the number of rune item drops, it is recommended to bring High Level Alchemy runes to reduce the frequency of banking and save inventory space.
Gargoyles can be safespotted near the doorway in the south-west area at the top floor in Slayer Tower or in the north-east corner of the basement behind an immovable bucket on the floor.

It should be noted that the gargoyles on the top floor of the tower are located after aberrant spectres , who drain players' stats if they are not wearing a Slayer helmet or nose peg . They may be avoided by using the Agility shortcut in the north-east from 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] to 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] , although this route takes longer. There's also a shortcut requiring 81 Agility outside the southern wall of the tower that will take you from the ground floor [ UK ] 1 st floor [ US ] to the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] . These gargoyles are susceptible to poison and venom ; the basement ones are immune to both.

In the book The Living Statues , it is revealed that the gargoyles were animated by the Bandosian general Snaarldor with the black tourmaline core , but turned against them after they ordered the gargoyles to fight against the forces of Zamorak , due to the Slayer Tower being filled with Zamorakian magic.
Being a golem , this creature is affected by golembane weapons .

source_context: Lizardman shamans are giant reptilian humanoids that are stronger than their normal lizardmen and lizardmen brute counterparts. They are often sought after for their dragon warhammer drops. They never become tolerant to the player.

Three shamans reside in the western area of Lizardman Canyon via the handholds . These three shamans are present in a multi-combat area . Shayzien soldiers will not attack the shamans (nor will the shamans attack them), since they are busy dealing with a small group of normal lizardmen . Below are a couple ways to get there.
Players can check how many players are currently in the western area of the canyon by speaking to the wounded soldier outside the canyon, just south of the broken crossbow.

Warning : Be wary of more than one shaman attacking at a time as they can quickly stack up damage from their abilities and attacks, which can quickly end a trip. To avoid being attacked constantly by the nearby lizardmen and their brute forms, killing the ones in the north and south-west corners is recommended.
Partial completion of Fairytale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings . A fairy ring (code D J R ) is nearby, just south of Lizardman Canyon .

Eight shamans reside inside a cave at the northern end of the Lizardman Settlement before Xeric's Shrine . This is a single-way combat area. This location requires players to be on a lizardman Slayer task. A dwarf multicannon cannot be used here.
Fairy rings Lizardman Settlement - (Slayer Only Cave)

Lizardman shamans have standard ranged and melee attacks, so one should use Protect from Missiles and stand at a distance. Unlike most monsters, lizardman shamans are able to attack with melee diagonally if the player is in range.

Lizardman shamans have several special attacks that they can utilise during the fight. Excluding the spawns, these attacks do not have a cooldown so it is possible for a lizardman shaman to repeatedly use the same ability over and over again.
